name: skreed-pre-launch
description: skreed.in pre-launch teaser: Astro 7 static on Cloudflare Workers + Static Assets
//build-modes: Section 4 ships one build in every mode (docs/specs/section-4-flux.md 5, Build modes): the five scene loops and their stills, with media-src 'self' written by csp.mjs for build, build:test and build:staging alike (E-S4-video as amended). build:test adds the hooks (__s4), build:staging the hooks and Tune. build and build:staging then run budget.mjs (section 6's lines and AC8's formats) and the post-build guard (exactly the ten loops, no land, park or garden asset, media-src 'self'). This note sits outside scripts so that npm run cannot run it.

scripts.dev: PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=1 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 PUBLIC_FAMILY_3D=on astro dev
scripts.build: PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=0 PUBLIC_TUNE=0 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs && node scripts/hero/budget.mjs dist --mode build && node scripts/room/guards.mjs --post-build --mode build
scripts.build:test: PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=0 PUBLIC_STAGING=0 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs
scripts.build:staging: PUBLIC_HERO_HOOKS=1 PUBLIC_TUNE=1 PUBLIC_STAGING=1 astro build && node scripts/csp.mjs && node scripts/hero/budget.mjs dist --mode staging && node scripts/room/guards.mjs --post-build --mode staging
